title: Marguerite and the Border
author: Jonah Winterbourne
blurb: Mara Fairweather, a burnt analyst bounced from three agencies, works cases no one wants attributed. Then every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
